content: 5) Techniques to inject clean lexical semantic knowledge from external resources into distributional word representations were proven to be effective in emphasizing the relation of semantic similarity. In particular, methods capable of transferring such knowledge from resource-rich to resource-lean languages BIBREF59 increased the correlation with human judgments for most languages, except for those with limited unlabelled data.
